title: Advanced Professional Certificate in Renewable Energy and Sustainability Management
description: The course will explore the renewable energy business development model and the renewable energy supply chain and risk management.
longDescription: The aim of this course is to provide an in-depth understanding of renewable energy, its nature, challenges, and business development model. The course will also cover the renewable energy supply chain, risk management, policies, and sustainable development, enabling students to comprehend the intricacies of renewable energy and its role in achieving sustainable development goals. By the end of the course, students will be able to analyze renewable energy policies, identify risks and opportunities in the renewable energy supply chain, and develop a business model for renewable energy ventures.
courseDetails: Fossil Fuel and Climate Change. Environment and Health Impacts of Fossil Fuel. The Environmental Impact of Renewable Energy. Renewable Energy Challenges and Opportunities. Energy Transition. Major Players in the Energy Sector. Renewable energy technologies. Renewable energy market forecast. Renewable energy business model. Major financing structures. The optimum financing structure. Challenges to renewable energy business model. Renewable energy storage. Energy transition focus area. Supply chain strategies for renewables. Renewable energy supply chain development. Supply Chain Ecosystem. Renewable energy risk management. Barriers to implementing renewable energy technologies (RET). Policymaking on Renewable Energy. Market Design and Regulations. Off-grid Policies. Polices on Decarbonization. International Initiatives for Climate Change. Energy Burden. Sustainable Energy. The circular economy. The aim of this course is to provide an introduction to renewable energy and its nature and challenges. The course will explore the renewable energy business development model and the renewable energy supply chain and risk management. The course will also cover renewable energy policies and their role in promoting sustainable development. By the end of this course, participants will have a broad understanding of renewable energy and its significance in achieving sustainable development goals. Participants will also gain insights into the business opportunities and risks associated with renewable energy projects. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following; Introduction to Renewable Energy: The Nature and Challenges of Renewable Energy: Renewable Energy Business Development Model: Renewable Energy Supply Chain and Risk Management: Renewable Energy Policies and Sustainable Development:
